name: hodge_tate_prismatic_comparison_constraint_canonical
description: Hodge-Tate weights, Frobenius eigenvalues, and Fontaine-Laffaille correspondence

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG not needed; Hodge-Tate comparison handled algebraically

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs

cvc5.reason: cvc5 used for UNSAT proofs on Hodge-Tate weight bounds and Frobenius eigenvalue constraints

sympy.reason: sympy used to verify Tate twist and Fontaine-Laffaille correspondence

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; p-adic Frobenius via cvc5/sympy

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; algebraic geometry handled symbolically

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; no graph structure

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; no hypergraph structure

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic computations sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology required

tate_twist.notes: T_p(μ_{p^∞}) is rank-1 with weight 1; eigenvalue p^{-1/2} from monodromy

positive.tate_crystalline: scalar in W(k) with Frobenius × p^{-1/2}

fontaine_laffaille.statement: For p > n+1, crystalline reps with HT-weights in [0,n] ↔ Dieudonné modules via F-crystals

fontaine_laffaille_fail.note: For p ≤ n+1, correspondence breaks; weights must be restricted
fontaine_laffaille_fail.example: p=3 for surface (n=2) violates p > n+1

rank_one_fcrystal.description: Rank-1 F-crystal is entirely determined by one Hodge-Tate weight w

p_to_infinity_limit.interpretation: Frobenius action vanishes in large characteristic
